title: Editor E6 slice: a block crosses columns in the Space page builder, by Alt and Left or Right and by a 44px button
detail:
Split from PROG-E6 on 2026-11-23: the first item of the 2026-11-18 fourth-slice note, a move across columns in the Space page builder (components/entity-blocks/space-canvas). Same gating as the builder had: the Space settings page and its owner-checked draft save; the node store only while render_path_space_profile is on. EDITOR_CANVAS and EDITOR_COLLAB are untouched.

Premise re-tested (ADR-1082) on main at b924aa21: the rail took Alt and Left or Right and moved nothing, and the canvas model had no operation across columns. One part of the premise was stale: the note says the move needs a model op, but lib/entity-blocks/node-ops.ts already had placeNode (any row, column, index) and rows-ops.ts placeBlock. What was missing was the rule for where one column over lands, and the wiring.

What now works. The rule is the website Layers one, not a second one: layerColumnTarget (lib/sites/editor/layer-focus.ts) read with a section as the holding block and its columns as the slots, so a block goes to the END of the neighbouring column of its own section. columnMoveTarget and moveNodeAcross in node-ops.ts wrap it for the Space document and refuse a column at the 12-block stack cap (normalizing would otherwise drop the block that arrived). Both canvas stores answer through it (the node store through its edit, the type-keyed store through placeBlock), so the move saves through the builder's one draft write, saveSpaceGridLayout, and nowhere else. On a rail tile Alt and Left or Right now moves the block and keeps focus on it; the key is still taken at an edge or in a one-column section so Back never fires. For a pointer or a finger the selected tile shows Move left or Move right, a 44px target with its words on it, only for a side that exists. A screen reader hears where the block went. The lock rule (partitionSpaceBlocks) decides what may be added to a page; a move adds nothing, so a live data section already placed (Events at its cap of one) crosses like any block and the write guard keeps it.

One fix found by the pictures: under the two-pane breakpoint the rail sits above the canvas, and the rail's line-up offset slid it down over the page it edits when a tile was selected (unreadable at 390px). The offset now applies only when the two panes are side by side.

VERIFIED: ten unit tests on the operation (first and last column, empty column, three columns, one column, cap, full column, bench, live data section through the write guard, the type-keyed rule); five component tests on the rail measuring the store and what the draft save is sent, on both stores; driven in Chromium on a harness page of the shipped editor at 390 (touch), 1280, 1440, 1920 and 2000: tap the tile, tap Move right, focus stays on the tile, Alt and Left brings it back, no sideways scroll, no page error. Pictures in /mnt/project-files/editor/e6-cross/. NOT VERIFIED: on the live Space settings route with a signed-in owner and a real database save; on a real phone; with a screen reader.

Known limits, stated plainly: the move is one column over inside a section, to the end of that column (a place inside the column is then Up and Down); there is no drag, by mouse or by finger, in this builder; the button shows on the selected tile only.

verify.note: Runs the shipped node-ops operation on a Space page document and the Space write guard, nothing replaced. Fails on main: the node store has no move across columns. Passes when a block goes to the end of the neighbouring column with its words, fills an empty column, stops at the first and last column, a one-column section moves nothing, an Events section at its cap crosses and survives the write guard, a full column refuses, and the rail wires the keys and a 44px button to it on both canvas stores.
